The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b0540eb39aad89c2), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let n ≥ 2, let Fq have characteristic p > n, let ℓ ̸= p, and put E = Qℓ. Let X0/Fq be a smooth projective geometrically connected curve of genus at least two, with x0 ∈ X0(Fq), and put U0 = X0 \ {x0}. Suppose ρ : πet 1 (U0) −→ PGLn(L) is continuous for a finite extension L/Qℓ, its geometric restriction is Zariski dense, and its inertia at x0 kills wild inertia and has the form ρ(γ) = exp tℓ(γ)N  (1.1) for a regular nilpotent N. Here a choice of compatible ℓ-power roots of unity identifies the tame quotient Zℓ(1) with Zℓ and defines tℓ. There are an integer m ≥ 1 and a nonzero E-adic Weil sheaf M0 on BunSLn,B,x0 (X0)Fqm whose geometric pullback M is locally constructible perverse and has singular support in Λpar. If ρm denotes the restriction of ρ to πet 1 (U0,Fqm ), then for every finite set I and every family Vi ∈ RepE(PGLn) there are isomorphisms of Weil sheaves HI,V (M0) ≃ M0 ⊠ ⊠ i∈I (Vi)ρm . (1.2) They are natural in the representations and coherent for the unit, convolution, permutations, and all fusion diagonals.
